text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (P1) fired — elevated 5xx on ingress-edge-west2. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 6% over 5m. Auto-runbooks attached: k8s-pod-scan, lb-weight-check.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-177777 created and routed to oncall. Escalation policy: edge-sre-team.

jamie: acked. I'm taking triage. quick check — any active deploys to ingress-edge-west2 in last 10m?

mike: Not from prod-deploys. I see a canary pushed ~7m ago to route weight alpha (0.05).

sasha: seeing steady 502s in the logs, traces point at upstream auth-proxy timed out. sample: ```2026-04-12T02:00:10Z ingress-edge error "upstream timeout" route=/v1/infer status=502 latency=1200ms```

lina: adding observability links: https://console.redwood.ai/edges/ingress-edge-west2/metrics (error rate chart), and traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/0xabc

jamie: assigning triage -> jamie (me). ops-sre, can you validate backend health? @ops-sre

ops-sre: checking pool sizes and pod restarts. `kubectl get pods -n ingress | grep ingress-edge` shows 3/3 ready, 0 restarts. Not seeing OOMs.

mike: I can temporarily reduce canary weight to 0 to see if it regresses. Anyone opposed?

sasha: +1 do it. logs show error rate spike aligns with canary rollout start at 02:00:03Z.

jamie: doing weight rollback now. `kubectl patch svc ingress-edge --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/alpha","value":0}]'`

pagerduty-bot: update: Incident INC-177777 annotated: canary weight rolled to 0.

sasha: after rollback, error rate dropping from 6.8% -> 3.2% in last 90s. Still watching.

lina: correlating customer impact: top 3 customers by failed requests are cust-phi, cust-delta, cust-alpha. Estimated impacted qps ~120 (12% of regional qps). Sending upstream notice to account owners.

mike: running heap/conn dump on auth-proxy just in case. posted snippet: ```curl -sS https://ingress-edge-west2/admin/debug | head -n 40``` shows a backlog of keepalive rejections.

ops-sre: I see increased 502s from upstream auth-proxy v2.1.5. Health check failing intermittently. I can spawn a hotfix rollout (v2.1.4 stable) into a small slice to validate.

jamie: agree. Plan: 1) keep canary weight 0, 2) roll auth-proxy back to 2.1.4 to a 10% slice, 3) monitor for 5m for error stabilizing, 4) escalate to oncall rotation if not improving. Anyone pick up rollout? @mike

mike: initiating rollback canary -> rolling a 10% slice of 2.1.4 to ingress-edge-west2 now.

incident-bot: Runbook step executed: rollback-upstream-version initiated by mike.

sasha: good signal: 502s drop to 1.1% after 2 minutes post-rollback. Latency also down.

lina: customer impact update: we've notified owners of cust-phi and cust-delta with initial message. I'll follow up with ETA once stable.

jamie: marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Keeping PD incident open for postmortem check. Can we capture a few logs and traces for RCA? Put a retention tag and snapshot traces.

ops-sre: saved trace snapshot and uploaded logs to //s3.redwood/incidents/INC-177777/logs.tar.gz. Added tag rca-needed=true.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-177777 status changed -> Acknowledged (mitigated).

lina: quick action items: - collect sample traffic that hit v2.1.5 canary - validate auth-proxy change log for timeout regression - confirm rollout gating for future canaries. I'll create a ticket INC-177777-POSTMORTEM and add owners.

mike: thumbs: :thumbsup: Can we add a quick guardrail: block canary traffic above 1% while upstream auth-proxy change in same release?

jamie: yes. filed a quick PR to infra: `infrastructure/edge-traffic-guards` to add a hard cap, PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3245 - reviewers: ops-sre, sasha.

sasha: agree to follow up with regression test in staging for auth-proxy timeouts.

jamie: final check — error rate is back to baseline 0.4% over last 5m, no new customer complaints in last 10m. Closing operational activity, leaving PD incident open for 24h and scheduling postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PST.

lina: noted. I'll notify stakeholders and set a calendar invite.

mike: thanks all. nice quick rollback.

incident-bot: Incident INC-177777 closed by pagerduty-bot (mitigated). Follow-up: postmortem ticket INC-177777-POSTMORTEM created.

jamie: closing thread. If any new regressions, re-open immediately. :white_check_mark:
